declarations.name: AuiNumberInput
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI NumberInput: `<aui-number-input>`.
Implements ControlValueAccessor and Validator (error key `aui`); `[(value)]` without forms.

inputs.name: hideLabel
inputs.description: Visually hide the label; it remains the accessible name.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Form field name, set on the hidden input that carries the canonical value.

inputs.name: placeholder
inputs.description: Supplementary hint; never replaces the label.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: Empty value is invalid; shows the required indicator.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Disables the input and steppers; the value is not submitted.

inputs.name: readOnly
inputs.description: Value is focusable and submitted but not editable or steppable.

inputs.name: min
inputs.description: Minimum value; also the step base and the Home target.

inputs.name: max
inputs.description: Maximum value; End goes to the largest on-grid value <= max.

inputs.name: step
inputs.description: Increment and step-validation grid (base min ?? 0). Default 0.01 for percent style. null: any value, increments of 1.

inputs.name: format
inputs.description: Display format (Intl.NumberFormat subset). maximumFractionDigits also rounds the value on commit.

inputs.name: validate
inputs.description: Consumer validation; return a message to mark the value invalid.

inputs.name: validationTiming
inputs.description: When validation messages first appear; afterwards they update live.

inputs.name: showSteppers
inputs.description: Render increase/decrease buttons (pointer affordance; keyboard users use the arrow keys).

models.name: value
models.description: The value: `[(value)]` without forms; with Angular forms, bind the form control instead.

outputs.name: valueInput
outputs.description: User typed, or stepped (keyboard or stepper buttons, since 0.9.0); value is the parse of the raw text.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: User committed a changed value (blur, Enter, arrow/page/Home/End keys, or a stepper button).

properties.name: formState
properties.description: Angular form state of this control.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error (server, cross-field rule); cleared when the user edits.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value and clear dirty/touched/submitted state.

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Spinbutton pattern on a text <input> with a <label for> association.

limitations: Values are JavaScript numbers (IEEE 754 doubles): integers beyond 2^53 and more than about 15 significant digits are not exact. Use Text Input for arbitrary-precision decimals.
Parsing follows the locale strictly: in de-DE a typed '.' is a group separator, so '1.5' is 15.
Group separators are accepted anywhere in the integer part; their positions are not validated.
Accounting formats (parentheses for negatives), scientific, engineering, and compact notation are not parsed.
The canonical value in the hidden input uses JavaScript number serialization, which is exponent notation below 1e-6 and from 1e21.
With inputMode 'numeric' (maximumFractionDigits 0) some mobile keyboards have no minus key; set min >= 0 or use the default decimal format for signed integers.
Stepper buttons do not repeat on press-and-hold.
